_about: Manual log of changes the free nflverse data cannot see (play-caller changes, trades, coaching and front-office changes). Not yet read by the app; scripts/backtest_context_change.py will use it once there is history to test. Entries: {team, season, effective_week, type, note, source}. effective_week is the first game affected. 'source' says who supplied it; schedule-derived dates were checked against games.csv.

changes.note: Sean Payton took back offensive play-calling from OC Davis Webb (decided Mon 10/5, announced Thu 10/8); first game Week 5 at LAC (W 23-17, 10/11).
changes.source: user-provided; week 5 date and result match games.csv

changes.note: DC Ejiro Evero and defensive passing game coordinator Jonathan Cooley fired after the Week 8 loss at GB; DL coach Todd Wash is interim DC; DeAngelo Hall added as CBs coach.
changes.source: user-provided; Week 8 loss at GB (19-27) matches games.csv

changes.note: Run game coordinator T.J. Paganetti fired after the Week 8 bye (18 rushing yards on 17 carries vs PIT in Paris).
GM Chris Ballard fired 10/19 after a 2-4 start and a loss to TEN; HC Shane Steichen retained for now.
changes.source: user-provided; 2-4 record and loss to TEN match games.csv
